dYdX is a decentralized derivatives exchange that offers perpetual futures trading. dYdX operates as a non-custodial platform in which users keep control of their funds. dYdX matches orders through an off-chain order book while settling trades on-chain. dYdX has been deployed on Ethereum through a layer 2 scaling solution and, in its later version, as its own blockchain application chain built with the Cosmos SDK.

Lido is a liquid staking protocol for proof-of-stake blockchains such as Ethereum. Lido issues a tokenized receipt, stETH, that represents staked ether and can be used while the underlying stake remains locked. Lido distributes staking across a set of node operators. Lido is governed by a decentralized autonomous organization that uses the LDO governance token.

MetaMorpho is a vault protocol built on top of Morpho lending markets. MetaMorpho vaults follow the ERC-4626 vault standard. MetaMorpho vaults allocate deposited assets across multiple underlying lending markets. MetaMorpho vaults are managed by curators who set the allocation and risk parameters.

LI.FI is a cross-chain routing and aggregation service for decentralized finance. LI.FI aggregates bridges and decentralized exchanges to find routes for token transfers and swaps across blockchains. LI.FI offers its functionality to developers through an API and software development kit.

Circle CCTP is a cross-chain transfer protocol for native USDC. Circle CCTP transfers USDC by burning it on the source blockchain and minting it on the destination blockchain. Circle CCTP relies on attestations issued by Circle to authorize minting on the destination chain.
